entries.2026ddcbdcc964a4: This business is the group's single reportable segment, providing BNPL (pay-later) payment services. Consolidated operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥25,214 million. Under the company, a pure holding company, Net Protections Inc. provides the various services in Japan, En Pei Ke Ji Gu Fen You Xian Gong Si (NP Taiwan, Inc.) operates AFTEE in Taiwan, and Net Protections Vietnam Co., Ltd. operates AFTEE in Vietnam. NP Finance Inc. provides online lending services to companies that buy through NP Kakebarai.
entries.4c87ec2f3b8bfb5f: A payment solutions company that provides B2C and B2B deferred payment (BNPL) services and handles credit screening, invoicing, and collection for merchants.
entries.6efcc6148c36d6f1: This segment covers atone, a membership-based BNPL payment service using smartphones. Payments are settled in one monthly bundle, points are granted, and it supports non-physical products such as digital content. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,977 million.
entries.bf2a3ec7622206a7: B2C Services – NP Atobarai and Others
entries.f50d87aa430a1a56: This segment covers NP Kakebarai, a deferred payment service mainly for small-value claims in business-to-business transactions. NP Handy Lending, an online lending service for purchasing companies, is provided by NP Finance Inc. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,740 million.
